builds.name: B20 Watchtower live index
builds.shortUpdate: Echo Shield now indexes the canonical Base B20 factory with durable coverage, configuration scans, and a free-tier watcher cadence.
builds.socialPost:
https://builtbyecho.xyz/security

Echo Shield's B20 Watchtower is live. It has indexed 7,800+ native B20 launches from the canonical Base factory and keeps a durable cursor at the chain head.

The watcher now runs inside our free-tier budget.
